scope: An independent criticism-tested reconstruction of Software Product Line Engineering as systematic engineering of related products through warranted commonality, managed variability, reusable assets and a defined derivation approach. Covers the ten mandated domain families, named historical/adoption/realisation/dynamic branches, and relevant evidence through 2026-09-06.
scope_boundaries: Not an exhaustive census of every publication, vendor, industry or national research programme. Saturation concerns the explicit questions and registered candidate mechanisms.
No requester repositories, prior Evolved packets, sibling corpora or target-specific designs were consulted.
Adjacent architecture, maintenance, control, ecosystems and learned-tool work is imported only with its source/transfer boundaries; no cross-trifecta synthesis is claimed.
No legal advice or invented standard clauses: external obligations are inputs and ISO evidence is limited to public scope.
No universal effect sizes, product-count thresholds, unqualified family proofs or claims of current industrial adoption from conference programmes.
evidence_limits: Bounded scope, not an exhaustive publication census.
Access limitations on specified original and current works; no uninspected methods, proof or outcomes imported.
Empirical settings and dependence constrain transfer; no universal break-even number, causal adoption benefit or general family-correctness guarantee.
One regeneration replacement candidate remains unresolved.
Analytical composition and constructed case checks are not empirical validation of the whole system.

EVIDENCE_PARTITIONS.EVIDENCE: 45 source records; separate access, theory, empirical, field, dependence and transfer information; no overall confidence percentage.

TENSIONS_AND_COMPOSITION.EVIDENCE: 10 tensions; 53 guarded relations; six alternatives; explicit feedback/communication/authority and eleven discriminating cases.

INTAKES.EVIDENCE: Complete audit population, public factual-claim intake and 62 globally keyed synthesis exports.

INDEPENDENCE.EVIDENCE: Only external scholarly/issuing-body sources; no sibling corpus, target repository or cross-trifecta synthesis used.

substantive_gate_interpretation: Authorial evidence/coverage judgement based on inspected sources and the stated scope, not independent external peer review. Automated tests attest structure, reconciliation and custody only.
